item.title: KSA-2026-014: Keystone Agent 6.2.1 fixes a local privilege escalation
item.description: Keystone Agent for Windows before 6.2.1 lets a signed-in user gain SYSTEM rights through the update service (CVSS 8.8). Update to 6.2.1. Keystone says the flaw is being exploited in limited attacks. There is no workaround.
